# ContainedList

- **ContainedListItem** (requires_parent): must be composed inside ContainedList; measured through ContainedList's samples.
- **ContainedListItem** (no_reference): no standalone upstream mount; measured through ContainedList's samples.
- **ContainedList** (superloom_decision): a ContainedList draws no outer margin - adjacent on-page lists' `control.contained_list_gap` is the host's spacing. Tag `lg` queued for v10 (CONTRACT-REQUESTS).
- **ContainedList** (superloom_decision): upstream's header is sticky inside a scroll container; a host scroll view pins it (`stickyHeaderIndices`), the list itself does not.

## ContainedList

ContainedList is a labelled list of rows inside a container, with a sticky header, an optional search and rulers between rows.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `composite` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `render-web` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | `compound-context`, `keyboard` |
| Flags | none |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `string` | yes | The header text labelling the list. |
| `kind` | `string` | no | `on-page` (default) or `disclosed` - the header's cells. |
| `size` | `string` | no | `sm` | `md` | `lg` (default) | `xl` - every item's minimum height and the tag height. |
| `isInset` | `boolean` | no | Insets the row rulers by the list's inline padding. |
| `action` | `node` | no | A header action: the string `search` draws a Search under the header filtering items by label; a node (`Search`/`ExpandableSearch`) does the same. |
| `items` | `array` | yes | The rows: `{ label, onPress, disabled, icon, action }`. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the root. |

### Metrics

| Metric | Rule |
|---|---|
| `actionSpace` | `control.contained_list_action_space` |
| `headerHeightDisclosed` | `control.contained_list_header_height_disclosed` |
| `iconGap` | `control.contained_list_icon_gap` |
| `iconSize` | `control.contained_list_icon_size` |
| `iconTop` | `control.contained_list_icon_top` |
| `paddingInline` | `control.contained_list_padding_inline` |

## ContainedListItem

ContainedListItem is one row of a ContainedList, optionally pressable, with an icon and an end action; it must be composed inside ContainedList, with no upstream visual reference of its own - it is measured through the list's samples.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `composite` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `none` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | `compound-context`, `keyboard` |
| Flags | `requires_parent` - renders only inside its parent; `no_reference` - no upstream visual reference; gates are structural, accessibility and cross-template |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `string` | yes | The row's text. |
| `onPress` | `function` | no | Makes the row a pressable with hover/active fills and the inset ring. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no | Dims the label and drops the press - only on a clickable row. |
| `icon` | `string` | no | A glyph name drawn in the icon column. |
| `action` | `node` | no | An end action over the row (`tag`, `button`, or a node). |
| `size` | `string` | no | Composition prop: the row's minimum height class from the list. |
| `inset` | `boolean` | no | Composition prop: the list insets the ruler. |
| `last` | `boolean` | no | Composition prop: the last row draws no ruler. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the root. |

### Metrics

| Metric | Rule |
|---|---|
| `actionSpace` | `control.contained_list_action_space` |
| `headerHeightDisclosed` | `control.contained_list_header_height_disclosed` |
| `iconGap` | `control.contained_list_icon_gap` |
| `iconSize` | `control.contained_list_icon_size` |
| `iconTop` | `control.contained_list_icon_top` |
| `paddingInline` | `control.contained_list_padding_inline` |

### States (sample.js)

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| default | `{"label":"List item"}` |
